about_the_game:
Çimen Adventures: Story Teller! Your Imagination Sets the Stage!

Each level is a new story waiting to be written! 🎭 In Çimen Maceraları, join Cem and Fazlı as they prank each other and stir up chaos. The goal? Craft the perfect narrative by placing characters and settings to solve puzzles and bring the story to life!

Drag and drop Cem, Fazlı, and their hilarious antics into scenes. Experiment with different combinations to discover unexpected twists and laugh-out-loud outcomes! 🌟

Shape the story! Will Cem win hearts, or will Fazlı’s stinginess backfire? Meet familiar faces from the Çimen Talk Show and enjoy seasons packed with clever challenges. ✨

Your story, your imagination, your Çimen Maceraları! Download now and start creating! 🚀
